original_test_intent: Validate every Type 44 Processor-Specific Block as a bounded architecture/vendor-defined payload attached to the correct Type 4 processor, preserving opaque data where semantics are unavailable and confirming stability after reboot.
original_method: Resolve the referenced processor, validate enclosing and block lengths from raw offset 06h, select the architecture/vendor schema, securely decode supported fields or mark bytes opaque, compare approved CPU/firmware baseline and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user supplies the applicable vendor/architecture schema and evidence policy and approves reboot; bounded parsing/comparison is automated and block bytes are never executed.
required_inputs: Expected Type4 processor identity and accepted block instances
Applicable architecture/vendor block schema and decoder version
Opaque/unknown semantics and sensitive-data handling policy
Raw Type4/44 parser and approved reboot/OOB plan
safety_requirements: Treat block bytes only as data; never execute them or use them for microcode/CPU configuration.
Resolve the Type4 target before selecting CPU/vendor interpretation.
Reconcile every block/data extent with the enclosing Type44 length.
Protect sensitive metadata; stop on CPU/management health loss and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve processor association, validate container/block bounds and architecture, decode only under an approved schema or report opaque hashes/raw evidence, then diff across reboot.
Report malformed, reserved, unresolved or drifting content without inventing semantics or assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Provide/approve vendor schema, expected fields, multi-block and evidence policy plus reboot plan.
Interpret opaque/vendor-defined fields and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep cannot prove block offset/length, processor association, architecture or payload semantics.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Store raw Type4/44 securely; emit processor identity, block offset/length/architecture, schema version, decoded-or-opaque field map, bounds and pre/post result.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Processor-Specific Block scope, script and 5/5-minute values remain; no CPU/firmware action is added.

modernized_recommendation.status: SCHEMA-BOUND OR OPAQUE-SAFE PROCESSOR BLOCK VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate the raw container and processor reference first, decode only with the matching architecture/vendor schema, otherwise preserve bounded opaque content and compare authorized fingerprints across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, processor/vendor schema, BIOS/microcode, parser/dmidecode and CPU inventory versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 44 container definition plus authoritative architecture/vendor block specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds processor binding, length proof, schema provenance and safe opaque handling.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects malformed/misattributed blocks and prevents fabricated interpretation while retaining exact stability evidence.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Vendor block schema or approved opaque-data policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Opaque stability proves persistence, not semantic correctness; engineer/vendor interpretation remains required for unsupported schemas.

project_override_considerations: Projects may accept opaque comparison when no public schema exists, but must not claim semantic correctness or execute the bytes; exact approved vendor schemas may extend decoded coverage.
expected_evidence: Approved Type4 association, block schema/opaque and evidence policy
Restricted pre-reboot raw Type4/44 with handles/lengths/block bytes
Per-block processor resolution, bounds, architecture and decoder/schema provenance
Decoded field comparison or authorized opaque fingerprint
Approved reboot/CPU/management health record and post-reboot diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source validly names the processor-specific container; missing vendor semantics are readiness inputs, not a source contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Bounds and opaque stability are automatable now; schema-based semantic checks become automatable when the vendor specification is supplied.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds processor reference, bounds, schema provenance, secure and opaque-safe handling.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains never-execute/no-invent safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability under supplied schema.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Does not convert absent private vendor documentation into permanent BLOCKED/PARTIAL classification.

review_improvement: Preserves useful structural/stability coverage without pretending that an unknown vendor payload has generic semantics or risking execution of its bytes.
independent_technical_reasoning: The standard defines a typed container whose payload semantics are external; independent review can prove framing and ownership, and can decode meaning only with the correct authoritative schema.
